newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 402,900 MT were 31 percent below the previous week and 15 percent and below the 4-week average. Major increases for Japan (102,800 MT, includes 145,100 new sales, 42,300 cancellations), Mexico (63,700 MT), the United Kingdom (54,600 MT, all destination changes), Israel (48,200 MT), and South Korea (45,400 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (116,800 MT).

Exports of 875,100 MT were one-third above the previous week and 16 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (105,600 MT), Malaysia (100,000 MT), South Korea (95,400 MT), Japan (64,300 MT), Spain (58,400 MT), and Taiwan (55,900 MT).
